headline: Approved consent agenda, including $653,933.55 in budget transfers; approved moving HS stove to new high school when built; tabled late bus presentation.
summary: The meeting covered state accountability and academic testing results, natural gas equipment replacement, and a Mustang Moment. Members approved the consent agenda, which included bills, a budget transfer, donations of $500 and $250 from First Baptist Church, and meeting minutes. They tabled the Medford High School late bus presentation until the next meeting.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda 7-0, including bills and payrolls, budget transfer Journal Entry #21162-$653,933.55, two First Baptist Church donations, and the minutes of the September 14, 2026 regular meeting.
Approved as amended that the new HS stove will find a new home when the new high school is built; all seven members voted yes on roll call.
Tabled the Medford High School Late Bus student advisory committee presentation to the next meeting; all seven members voted yes on roll call.
